label: Real data render
alt: A replay of one kit scroll2ink run: its stage lines appear one by one in a terminal on the left, each with its recorded time (the scan and an umbilicus for the layer order, the seed check, a 4.8 cm2 trace grown in 136 s, the check passing with 5 of 5 windows seated, an extension dropped because it failed the same check, flatten, a 28-layer render, then on a GPU the ink step with its reverse control, previews and the report), and on the right a CT slice of PHerc0139 through the seed point with a ring on the seed and the ten stages lighting up.
caption: Real data render: a replay of kit scroll2ink on Hugging Face Jobs, 25 Oct 2026, PHerc0139 at 9.362 um (CPU part for VC3D, then an L4 GPU for ink); every line and time read from the run's logs, waits skipped. PHerc0139, volume 20250728140407 (9.362 um), CT slice z 5477, x 3737 to 4505, y 3551 to 4319; the ring is the seed. CT only: the grown surface and the ink maps are model output and stay numbers.
